law: Use NetworkingDriverKit to develop drivers for USB Ethernet adapters.
It also provides support for managing the memory you use to store packets, transferring those packets between the device and networking stack, and inspecting the Ethernet link status.
Use USBDriverKit to manage the connection to your hardware device.
Include your driver inside your macOS app and use the framework to install and upgrade the driver on the user’s Mac.
Override this method and use it to start or stop the delivery of packets to and from the device.
For example, change the enabled state of the queues you use to handle packets moving to or from the device.
Limit the work you do in this method to simple tasks that must occur before your service stats.
For example, you might use this method to allocate memory for your structure.
Always call the implementation of this method at some point.
